prompt: On a dot plot, each dot represents ___?
hint: Think about how a dot plot is built: a dot is added every time a value is recorded.

hints.text: Think about how a dot plot is built: a dot is added every time a value is recorded.
If a value occurs three times in the data, three dots are stacked above it. So a single dot stands for a single piece of data.
Each dot represents one data point (one value).

explanation: A dot plot is made by placing a dot above a number each time that number appears in the data.
So the number of dots above a value equals how many times that value was observed.
That means each dot represents one data point.
